description: Lessons: what a widget's method IS, named in the discipline's terms, run on its own data, with the assumption it inherits varied and the effect shown as a number. Separate from widgets/parity.json because the two answer to different readers and fail in different ways -- a parity notebook fails by disagreeing, a lesson fails by teaching the tool instead of the subject -- and because parity results are pinned by commit and digest into a release's evidence, so improving an explanation used to move that pin. See docs/experiments/94-where-explanation-belongs.md.
legacyNote: The twenty sections still living as trailing cells in validation-lab notebooks are recorded on widgets/parity.json's `diveDeeper` field and counted below. They predate the pedagogical requirements and meet the older, narrower definition -- vary the assumption -- so rewriting one against the requirements is new work and not a file move. The ceiling may fall and never rise.

entries.title: Where the centre of an outbreak is, and what moves it
entries.teaches: The mean centre as the centroid of a point mass system; why it is projected to metres first; and what the weighting, the choice of mean against median centre, and the projection each cost -- 2.10 m, 6.62 m and 0.001 m on Snow's 250 addresses.

entries.title: What a street network is, and what the filter decided
entries.teaches: A street network as a directed graph -- order, size, degree, components, length in metres -- and what the mode filter decides: on the Soho snapshot a driving filter drops 918 of 1,619 edges and 24.35 of 50.30 km, and 455 edges carry a vehicle one-way a walking graph ignores.
